summary: News Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 1, 2026, disclosing daily ASX repurchase-program updates as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. The registrant, an issuer dual-listed on Nasdaq (NWSA/NWS) and ASX, is authorized to buy back up to $1 billion in aggregate of Class A and Class B common stock. No price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated; buybacks occur from time to time under the existing authorization. Watch the pace and mix of Class A versus Class B repurchases as a signal of capital-return commitment and potential NAV support, with liquidity and market-price risk the key variables.
